limits: Signals actual /proc PID/UID/start/ELF metadata are captured receipts, not retained full raw proc filesystem files.
Ready two cases have real stopped resource snapshots; blocked two have no stopped output or backend resource proof while stdout stays unread, only actual exit and two TCP EOF observations.
Both scripts sample data EOF after process wait; do not claim EOF timestamp before exit.
Old BP two cases expose only stdout summary and exact wrapper command/binary guard, not perchild PID/proc ELF or raw protocol frames. Do not borrow signal perchild evidence for BP.
Pure ordinary-user virtual loopback, no physical/kernel USB, hardware or QEMU.
This parser does not independently remap Git or rebuild the binaries; source receipt and read-only frozen script hashes are checked. Diagnostic 9+4 cases are separately reviewed by N.
